messages:
Eli K.: FYI we finished the 8h canary for adaptive-time-slicing (ATS) on chat-medium and embedder mixes. Traffic: 10%. High level: p95 down ~18% for chat-medium, embedder throughput +9%, estimated token cost down ~12%. No customer errors.

perf-bot: ```
CANARY REPORT (adaptive-time-slicing v2)
workloads: chat-medium (avg seq 640), embedder-batch (avg seq 128)
baseline: chat p50=82ms p95=290ms p99=610ms cost=$14.8/1M tokens
canary:   chat p50=70ms p95=240ms p99=520ms cost=$13.0/1M tokens
          embed p50=18ms p95=64ms p99=110ms throughput +9%
delta:    chat p95 -17% p99 -15% cost -12%
canary-id: ats-v2-1943210000
notes: stable across instance types; slight higher p50 variance in ap-northeast-1 (see infra note)
```

Sofia R.: Great! Did we see any cold-start amplification or KV cache pressure with the new slicing boundaries?

Eli K.: We measured cold-starts: warm hit rate stayed ~98.6%. KV cache requests per second increased by ~3%, within capacity. We added a soft throttling guard to avoid overpacking small sparse requests. Config used:

```yaml
adaptive_time_slicing:
  enabled: true
  slice_window_ms: 10
  min_slice_tokens: 16
  max_pack_tokens: 4096
  strategy: time-slice-v2
  soft_throttle_threshold_qps: 1200
  metrics_tag: ["ats_v2_canary"]
```

Theo M.: Observability note: ap-northeast-1 had a short bump in p50 at 09:07 UTC caused by a noisy NIC on node-az3. infra-bot rolled that host out of LB automatically; related traces show queue_time spiked ~40ms for affected requests. No relationship to ATS logic found. Link: https://console/traces/1943210000

infra-bot: auto-remediation: host node-az3 removed from loadbalancer at 2026-03-13T09:08:12Z, replacement in 45s.

Sofia R.: Any change in GPU memory patterns? Packing more tokens could increase peak memory per device.

Eli K.: Peak GPU mem increased ~2% on p4d instances for embedder workloads, under safe margins. We added a per-batch token cap and fallback to legacy packer when mem pressure > 78%. Fallback engaged in 0.2% of canary traffic.

perf-bot: ```
DASHBOARD SNAPSHOT (sample)
- packed_token_count: mean=920 median=780 p95=2900
- pack_success_rate: 99.1%
- fallback_rate: 0.9%
- estimated_cost_saving: 12.3%
- embedder_throughput_gain: +9.1%
```

Eli K.: Next steps: promote to 30% in 24h, then 60% in 48h if no high-severity flags. I'll open rollout PR with the rollback steps and the playbook for oncall. Filed GH #2048 with logs and perf dashboards.

Theo M.: Please add a small histogram of per-slice token distribution to the perf dashboard and region split for the mem pressure metric. Will help tune slice_window_ms per region.

Sofia R.: Can we also schedule the nightly drift job to run ATS-specific long-seq checks (12h runs)? I want to detect slow regressions when models/ops change.

Eli K.: Added a todo in GH #2048 to enable nightly drift runs and link them into the canary dashboard. Also added an automatic rollback if fallback_rate > 3% sustained for 5m.

perf-bot: note: promotion to 30% scheduled 24h after canary end (auto).

Eli K.: Thanks everyone. If you see anomalies after bump ping @eli. Closing thread, will post rollout PR here when opened. :rocket:
